about: probe:p360 grader fixtures (build/p360/SPEC.md §8): a parent-shaped and a HEAD-shaped honest reading per arm and RUN, hand-written to the shape an honest run records (no builder launches Electron); a broken reading per clause, each failing exactly the clauses it names; an unreadable one per need; raw inputs (wrapper log lines in the shape build/p360/local-tmux.sh and build/p326/far-tmux.sh write, app.log records, the app output Electron prints for a handler that threw, tmux lists, the window’s status sequence) through the run’s own readers; and reader checks. A verifier may replace the honest readings with a kept run’s (P360_KEEP=1). Entries named “review: …” are the probe review’s (2026-11-08), each from RECORDED raw input: build/p360/local-tmux.sh and build/p326/far-tmux.sh run with the probe’s own rules against scratch servers of the vendored tmux 3.7b, app.log lines built by the product’s own buildLogLine with the messages read from its source, and Node’s own output of real GmuxError and SqliteError rejections; per grader an honest reading of the reviewer’s own and broken ones (a create that answered a failure for a running pane, a second press that made two sessions, a remote sentence saying nothing changed beside a kept row). Entries named “his ruled round: …” (2026-11-14) are that round’s: L1 and L2 at HEAD answer as the parent does by his ruling and are told apart by app.log, both read a busy window (busyReading over what the page records by its own clock), and the probe review’s recorded HEAD readings are re-read with the sheet as his ruling has it. Entries named “ruled review: …” are the probe review of his ruled round (2026-11-14): the four L1 and L2 readings and the busy-window records RECORDED in the two live runs made that day on these trees (the parent then HEAD, and the parent then the fix round’s build, whose window moved), each graded whole; and hostile ones the round’s fixtures lacked, for the two grader fixes it made: the create’s answer read behind the long task beside the notice (busy.answerQueued), and the parent’s L1 told apart only over an app.log that was read (its latch line). Entries named “his second ruled round: …” (2026-11-16) are that round’s: the four remote stop arms (R7L, R7, RF, RN), each a create on another machine during which the session list stopped after that machine answered; R7L and R7 read the same clauses at both builds, by his second ruling; a broken reading per clause (his first ruling’s answer, the stopped sentence for a session running over there, among them), an unreadable one per need, raw far logs and app.log lines through the run’s own readers, and reader checks. Their honest readings are recorded from the round’s last whole run (both builds, every arm, D26 built). Entries named “second ruled review: …” are the probe review of his second ruled round (2026-11-16): the need it added to R7L, R7 and RF@head (a list of that machine had shown the session, read off D12’s line), with RN@head’s RECORDED readings through RF@head’s grader, which read FAIL (D26 built) and PASS (D25 alone) before it; RECORDED honest readings of every new grader from runs other than the builder’s source (26998, 37992, 57022, 5287, 67362), each graded whole; RECORDED broken ones (RN at HEAD with D25 alone, each build through the other’s grader) and compositions of recorded halves; and three readings re-derived from their runs’ kept far log and app.log (cut to the arm’s window) through the run’s own readers, with reader checks of that raw text against each run’s own recorded values. App.log lines naming a path under /Users/ are left out of the embedded text, and none of them is a line a reader counts. Entries named “his third ruled round: …” (2026-11-17, “360 a then ship 115.0”) are that round’s: RF, RN and the new RFL read the same clauses at both builds, the parent’s, as R7L and R7 do; every typing reading is real keystrokes read back by typedReading; the ten remote stop graders’ honest readings are RECORDED from the round’s whole run, a broken reading per clause and an unreadable one per need are ops over them, raw entries read this run’s recorded captures and app.log lines and the last reverify’s recorded HEAD lines for RF and RFL through the run’s own readers, and the earlier remote entries the new graders could not judge (renamed needs and clauses) were removed. Entries named “third ruled review: …” are the probe review of his third ruled round (2026-11-17): per remote stop grader an honest reading RECORDED from whole3 (run 29875, not whole4, the builder’s source), whole, its app.log, its real-keystroke captures and its far log through the run’s own readers; broken ones recorded where a run recorded them (whole2’s RN@parent with its text lost, his second ruled round’s HEAD in RF and RN from run 54265, the last reverify’s R7L1 window) and from this review’s own captures of the vendored tmux 3.7b, the typed fields composed where a run read no keys and said so in the name; one unreadable reading per grader for the review’s grader fix (a capture never read is no reading, never a FAIL); and typedReading over those captures.
